text: こんな　うわさが…　キクコは　わかい　とき　オーキドはかせと　ライバルで　つよさを　きそって　いたらしい！

structure.jp: キクコは　わかい　とき
オーキドはかせと　ライバルで
structure.en: she was rivals with Professor Oak, and

structure.jp: つよさを　きそって　いたらしい！

patterns.name: 〜らしい
patterns.span: きそって　いたらしい
patterns.explanation: らしい at the end says 'apparently', for something you heard and did not see yourself. きそって　いたらしい = 'apparently they used to compete'.

patterns.name: 〜とき
patterns.explanation: とき after a describing word or verb means 'at the time when'. わかい　とき = 'when she was young'.

patterns.name: 〜で (linking)
patterns.explanation: で here is the 'and' form of だ, joining 'was a rival' to what comes next. ライバルで = 'was a rival, and'.
